findings.title: Integer overflow accepted as zero during artifact sealing
findings.input: Provision fixture EXECUTOR with project grant; upload empty bytes; POST /artifacts with matching empty content hash/storage_key, byte_size=json.Number("1e21"), run_id=null, kind=REPORT, evidence_kind=GENERATED, measurement_mode=FIXTURE, access_class=PROJECT, current If-Match and fresh idempotency key.
findings.observed: HTTP 201; returned Artifact.byte_size=1e21 despite content length zero.
findings.raw_test_output: accepted empty bytes with byte_size=1e21: status=201 byte_size=1e+21
findings.cause: Num discards json.Number.Int64 conversion error and returns zero; seal compares that zero to len(empty content). Schema permits integer byte_size without an upper bound.
findings.expected: Reject invalid/out-of-range integer conversion or compare requested byte size exactly with actual length; do not persist incorrect metadata.
findings.follow_up: Owner reported repair underway; not independently retested in this record.

findings.title: Cursor reused with different event query
findings.input: Create project and accepted requirement; GET /events?limit=1&after_sequence=0, then reuse next_cursor with /events?after_sequence=100&limit=1&cursor=<cursor>.
findings.observed: HTTP 200 returned an EventEnvelope with sequence=2 and snapshot_event_sequence=3.
findings.raw_test_output: changed query accepted: status=200; items[0].sequence=2; snapshot_event_sequence=3
findings.cause: Reviewed cursor branch bound principal/project/operation/grant_hash but ignored changed after_sequence.
findings.expected: Reject cursor whose bound query differs from the request.
findings.follow_up: Parent reports later integrated commit 6b9e6dc has operationKey including limit/after_sequence. This record does not invalidate that revision; compare its source/hash and rerun changed-query counterexample during final review.

findings.title: Slow request body holds the sole database connection
findings.input: Authenticated GET /state uses synthetic ReadCloser that signals Read entry then blocks until released. While its body read is blocked, run another authenticated GET /state with a 150ms context deadline; release first body after second returns.
findings.observed: Second request returned HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR while waiting for the sole SQLite connection.
findings.raw_test_output: request body blocked unrelated database read: status=500 body.code=INTERNAL_ERROR; body.retryable=false
findings.cause: handle begins transaction before reading request body; store permits one open connection. Runtime server had ReadHeaderTimeout but no body deadline in the reviewed snapshot.
findings.expected: Perform bounded body reading outside the database transaction and use finite request body read limits/deadlines.
findings.follow_up: Owner reported repair underway; not independently retested in this record.
